title: Data migration (migrations/<version>.json)

kind.description: Whether the step changes actors or items.

type.title: Name
type.description: The actor or item type whose data the step changes.

path.title: Field path
path.description: Field names joined by dots, such as `stats.hp`. `*` stands for every row of a collection: `inventory.*.weight`.

to.description: The field’s new name; it stays where it is: `stats.hp` to `health` gives `stats.health`.

kind.description: Whether the step changes actors or items.

type.title: Name
type.description: The actor or item type whose data the step changes.

path.title: Field path
path.description: Field names joined by dots, such as `stats.hp`. `*` stands for every row of a collection: `inventory.*.weight`.

to.title: Field path
to.description: Where the value goes. Objects on the way are created. A `*` row stays the same row: `inventory.*.wt` can move to `inventory.*.weight`, not out of the row.

oneOf.description: Moves a field’s value to another path.
oneOf.title: Move step

kind.description: Whether the step changes actors or items.

type.title: Name
type.description: The actor or item type whose data the step changes.

path.title: Field path
path.description: Field names joined by dots, such as `stats.hp`. `*` stands for every row of a collection: `inventory.*.weight`.

value.description: The value it gets; it must fit the field.

oneOf.description: Gives a field a value where the entity has none, such as an existing entity’s value for a new field whose default is meant for new ones.
oneOf.title: Set default step

kind.description: Whether the step changes actors or items.

type.title: Name
type.description: The actor or item type whose data the step changes.

path.title: Field path
path.description: Field names joined by dots, such as `stats.hp`. `*` stands for every row of a collection: `inventory.*.weight`.

oneOf.description: Removes a field and its value.
oneOf.title: Drop step

items.description: One change to the data. A step whose field an entity does not have does nothing to it.

steps.description: Run in order, on each actor and item of the types they name.

description: A data migration: steps that bring actors and items made with an older version up to the version the file is named after.
